info.title: PandaOPDS
info.description: PandaOPDS management and reading API. Basic authentication applies when both AUTH_USERNAME and AUTH_PASSWORD are configured, subject to configured path exemptions. E-Hentai account credentials are configured server-side. Archive start and refresh can spend GP.

get.description:
Root OPDS 1.2 navigation feed (hard-coded, no home.toml).

Pure standard navigation: Latest / Watched / Favorites / Popular /
Toplist (single entry; period facets live inside the toplist feed) +
a trailing protocol-level Search link.  Watched/Favorites are omitted
when no IPB cookie is configured.

pagination uses `page` (1-based, `?p=` upstream) — not the lastGid
`next` mechanism used by the front-page feeds. Pure standard Atom, no
extensions (v1.2 constraint).

get.description:
Recently Read shelf, ordered by latest reading progression timestamp — backed by local progression store.

Pagination mirrors toplist (`page` 1-based).

Detail feed: archived galleries prefer cached online detail HTML and
fall back to the local archive snapshot when upstream is unavailable.

Fetching the detail page also pre-warms the page-URL mapping cache so the
first /stream request skips one upstream round trip.

get.description: Root OPDS 2.0 document. Each TOML [[section]] selects a source and placement. A grouped publication or navigation section creates one groups[] item containing one collection. Ungrouped sections populate top-level publications, navigation, or facets. Top-level publications and groups are mutually exclusive; top-level navigation may coexist with either. A facet section requires a matching ungrouped publication source. Watched and Favorites require IPB cookies; Archives requires ready entries. If no content collection can be shown, the feed contains a Latest navigation link.

200.description: Navigation and available publication previews. The Go service waits up to 12 seconds for previews and marks the response no-store if the deadline is reached.

get.description: Custom OPDS 2.0 page feed defined in home.toml. Supports publications stream mode and sections/groups mode.

get.description: Returns a Readium Divina manifest with a nonempty per-page readingOrder. Metadata prefers the upstream detail page, so archived galleries keep comments, subjects and favorites; subjects follow TAG_TRANSLATION_ENABLED exactly like gallery feeds. When an associated local ZIP master is readable, readingOrder pages and numberOfPages come from that file; the local publication snapshot is used only when upstream is unavailable. If the page count is unknown or zero, returns 503 because a valid Divina manifest cannot be produced.

503.description: Gallery page count unavailable or upstream service unavailable

get.description: Legacy URL retained for clients that saved it. New catalog entries link to `/manifest`. Returns a top-level publication object. Ready archives prefer online detail-page HTML and use the local snapshot when upstream is unavailable.

get.description:
Proxy a cover/preview URL (settings.image_proxy_hosts) same-origin.

Comment content (x:reviews) may embed eh/ex cover images on a different
origin; a web client fetching them cross-origin hits CORS. This endpoint
fetches the exact bytes through the throttled, authenticated client and
serves them from the PandaOPDS origin. The URL is treated as opaque (no
gid/token parsing).

post.description: Starts a scan of ARCHIVE_DIR. The default scan only walks paths and reads file stat metadata; it does not open ZIP payloads or calculate hashes. Deep inspection requires {"deep":true,"acknowledged":true}; it reads image pages and computes SHA-256, which may cause substantial I/O on a network-mounted drive. It does not perform a full ZIP CRC check. Startup does not automatically scan this directory; run a normal scan to discover files. Repeated requests while running share the current job.

post.description:
Purge the on-disk image cache.

Disk entries live up to 7 days, so stale bytes (e.g. thumbnails cached
before a cover-proxy fix) need an explicit clear. Memory caches are left
untouched — they hold URLs/metadata and expire within minutes/hours.
Route is covered by Basic Auth when enabled (same as the rest of WebUI).

version_update.description: Progress or failure of the latest attempted gallery version update.

favcat.description: Required for add or move. Ignored for remove.

url.description: HTTPS gallery URL on the configured EH or EX host.

rating.description: Rounded to the nearest half-star, clamped to 0.5–5.0.

group.description: Create one independent group for this section. Facets must use false.

title.description: Display title. Defaults to the query when omitted.

query.description: For type=subscription, the ID of an existing local subscription.

count.description: Publication preview limit. Null or omitted uses 10; 0 disables the preview.

facet_set.description: ID of the referenced global facet set (for kind='facets').

items.description: Navigation items for a grouped navigation section sharing the same group title.

title.description: Display title of the navigation item.

query.description: For type=subscription, the ID of an existing local subscription.

gid.description: Use 0 with an empty token to unlink the document while preserving its file.

categories.description: Included EH gallery category IDs. Search, latest, and watched apply them upstream where supported; popular, toplist, and favorites presets filter fetched results locally. Existing cached items remain stored and are filtered from output using the current selection.

max_pages.description: Compatibility field; the server normalizes every subscription to one upstream page per run.

page_count.description: Zero means the archive has not yet been indexed by opening its manifest or a page.

id.description: Page slug identifier ('home' for root page)
